constraints.name: children_display_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM display_name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM display_name)) <= 120)))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM batch_name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM batch_name)) <= 120)))

constraints.name: class_setup_begin_requests_course_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM course_name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM course_name)) <= 120)))

constraints.name: class_setup_intent_history_workspace_id_completed_course_i_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, completed_course_id) REFERENCES courses(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: class_setup_ack_requires_completion
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT acknowledged) OR (completed_course_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: class_setup_intents_workspace_id_completed_batch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, completed_batch_id) REFERENCES batches(workspace_id, id)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, course_id) REFERENCES courses(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: class_setup_session_series_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((isfinite(start_date) AND isfinite(end_date) AND (end_date >= start_date) AND ((duration_minutes >= 1) AND (duration_minutes <= 1440)) AND ((occurrence_count >= 1) AND (occurrence_count <= 104))))

constraints.name: class_setup_session_series_workspace_id_batch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id) REFERENCES batches(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: class_setup_workspace_versions_workspace_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: connection_events_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((connection_request_id IS NOT NULL) OR (workspace_child_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: connection_approval_integrity
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'approved'::text) AND (child_id IS NOT NULL) AND (guardian_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'approved'::text) AND (confirmed_by IS NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: guardian_pending_identity_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((initiation_type <> 'guardian'::text) OR (status <> 'pending'::text) OR ((child_id IS NOT NULL) AND (guardian_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: enrollment_request_receipts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((operation = 'save'::text) AND (requested_status IS NULL) AND (expected_version IS NULL) AND (reason IS NULL)) OR ((operation = 'change'::text) AND (requested_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text, 'completed'::text, 'withdrawn'::text])) AND (expected_version > 0) AND (((requested_status = ANY (ARRAY['paused'::text, 'withdrawn'::text])) AND (reason IS NOT NULL)) OR ((requested_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text])) AND (reason IS NULL))))))

constraints.name: enrollments_workspace_id_batch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id) REFERENCES batches(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: enrollments_workspace_id_child_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, child_id) REFERENCES workspace_children(workspace_id, child_id)

constraints.name: family_invites_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((accepted_by IS NULL) AND (child_id IS NULL) AND (relationship_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NULL)) OR ((accepted_by IS NOT NULL) AND (child_id IS NOT NULL) AND (relationship_id IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: parent_items_workspace_id_batch_id_child_id_enrollment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id, child_id, enrollment_id) REFERENCES enrollments(workspace_id, batch_id, child_id, id)

constraints.name: parent_items_workspace_id_batch_id_source_session_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id, source_session_id) REFERENCES schedule_sessions(workspace_id, batch_id, id)

constraints.name: parent_signal_request_receipt_workspace_id_batch_id_sessio_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id, session_id, child_id, signal_id) REFERENCES parent_signals(workspace_id, batch_id, session_id, child_id, id)

constraints.name: parent_signals_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((type = 'missing_today'::text) AND (reason IS NOT NULL) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['unwell'::text, 'travelling'::text, 'other'::text]))) OR ((type <> 'missing_today'::text) AND (reason IS NULL))))

constraints.name: parent_signals_workspace_id_batch_id_child_id_enrollment_i_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id, child_id, enrollment_id) REFERENCES enrollments(workspace_id, batch_id, child_id, id)

constraints.name: parent_signals_workspace_id_batch_id_session_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id, session_id) REFERENCES schedule_sessions(workspace_id, batch_id, id)

constraints.name: profiles_display_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((display_name IS NULL) OR (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM display_name)) > 0)))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: schedule_sessions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((isfinite(starts_at) AND isfinite(ends_at) AND (ends_at > starts_at) AND ((ends_at - starts_at) <= '24:00:00'::interval) AND (mod(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ends_at - starts_at)), (60)::numeric) = (0)::numeric)))

constraints.name: schedule_sessions_workspace_id_batch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, batch_id) REFERENCES batches(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: workspace_creation_receipts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((original_name IS NULL) AND (original_type IS NULL)) OR ((original_name IS NOT NULL) AND (original_type IS NOT NULL) AND (original_type = ANY (ARRAY['independent'::text, 'academy'::text])))))
